### Enable Entire CLI with Auto-Commit Strategy

Source: https://github.com/entireio/cli/blob/main/README.md

Enables the Entire CLI in a repository using the 'auto-commit' strategy. This command sets up the necessary hooks and configurations for automatic commit management.

```bash
entire enable --strategy auto-commit
```

--------------------------------

### Entire CLI Configuration Settings

Source: https://context7.com/entireio/cli/llms.txt

Configuration for Entire CLI is managed through JSON files. '.entire/settings.json' contains project-specific settings committed to git, while '.entire/settings.local.json' holds local overrides and is gitignored.

```json
// .entire/settings.json (project settings, committed to git)
{
  "strategy": "manual-commit",
  "agent": "claude-code",
  "enabled": true,
  "strategy_options": {
    "push_sessions": true,
    "summarize": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  },
  "telemetry": true
}

// .entire/settings.local.json (local overrides, gitignored)
{
  "enabled": false,
  "log_level": "debug"
}
```

Source: https://context7.com/entireio/cli/llms.txt

To enable Entire CLI with the `auto-commit` strategy, run `entire enable --strategy auto-commit` within your project directory. This configuration will automatically create checkpoints after each AI agent response, ensuring that your development history is captured continuously. The output will indicate that hooks are installed and the project is configured for this automatic checkpointing strategy.

--------------------------------

Source: https://github.com/entireio/cli/blob/main/README.md

Entire uses two configuration files located in the `.entire/` directory: `settings.json` and `settings.local.json`. The `settings.json` file is shared across the team and is typically committed to git. It contains project-wide settings such as the `strategy`, `agent`, and whether Entire is `enabled`. The `settings.local.json` file is for personal overrides and is gitignored by default. It can be used to configure local settings like `enabled` status or `log_level`.

### Enable Entire CLI with Force Reinstall

Source: https://github.com/entireio/cli/blob/main/README.md

Enables the Entire CLI and forces a reinstallation of hooks, removing any existing Entire hooks before setting up new ones. This is useful for troubleshooting or updating configurations.

```bash
entire enable --force
```

--------------------------------

### Diagnose and Fix Stuck Sessions with Entire Doctor

Source: https://context7.com/entireio/cli/llms.txt

The 'doctor' command diagnoses and fixes issues with stuck Entire sessions. It checks for orphaned session state files, shadow branches without corresponding sessions, and corrupted metadata.

```bash
# Diagnose and fix issues with stuck sessions
entire doctor

# Checks for:
# - Orphaned session state files
# - Shadow branches without corresponding sessions
# - Corrupted metadata
```

--------------------------------

### Rewind to Previous Checkpoint

Source: https://github.com/entireio/cli/blob/main/README.md

Command to revert your project to a previous saved state (checkpoint) within the current AI agent session. It displays available checkpoints and allows selection for restoration.

```bash
entire rewind
```

### Troubleshooting > Common Issues

Source: https://github.com/entireio/cli/blob/main/README.md

If you encounter the error "Not a git repository", navigate to a Git repository first. If Entire is disabled, run `entire enable`. When "No rewind points found" occurs, work with Claude Code and commit (manual-commit) or wait for agent response (auto-commit). For "shadow branch conflict", run `entire reset --force`.

--------------------------------

### entireio/cli > PostToolUse[TodoWrite]

Source: https://github.com/entireio/cli/blob/main/docs/architecture/claude-hooks-integration.md

The `PostToolUse[TodoWrite]` hook is invoked whenever a subagent updates its todo list, facilitating fine-grained, incremental checkpointing during subagent execution. It first checks for an active pre-task file to ensure it's operating within a subagent task context; otherwise, it skips silently. The hook then detects file changes by comparing the current git worktree status against the last checkpoint. If no changes are detected, it returns without creating a checkpoint. It extracts the content of the last completed todo item from the `tool_input.todos` array to use as the checkpoint description. A sequence number is obtained for the checkpoint, and then a `TaskCheckpointContext` is built with `IsIncremental: true` and the todo content. This context is used to save an incremental checkpoint via `strategy.SaveTaskCheckpoint`, resulting in a small commit that captures the progress.

# Todoist MCP Server (Go)

[![Build and Test](https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml)
[![Go Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Go-1.26-00ADD8?logo=go&logoColor=white)](https://go.dev/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Todoist, written in Go. This server enables Claude and other MCP clients to interact with your Todoist tasks, projects, sections, labels, and comments using natural language. Includes GTD workflow tools for inbox processing and weekly reviews.

This is a Go rewrite of the original [TypeScript implementation](https://github.com/abhiz123/todoist-mcp-server), built with the official [go-sdk v1.3.0](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk).

## Features

- **Full Todoist API Coverage**: 29 tools covering tasks, projects, sections, labels, and comments
- **GTD Workflow Support**: Inbox review, weekly review, task moving, and bulk creation
- **Smart Task Search**: Locate tasks via exact or partial name matching
- **Flexible Filtering**: Organize tasks by due date, priority, project, and more
- **Task ID Support**: Use task IDs directly or search by name

## Available Tools

### Task Tools (6)

| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `todoist_create_task` | Create a new task | `content`, `description`, `due_string`, `priority`, `project_id`, `section_id`, `parent_id`, `labels`, `assignee_id` |
| `todoist_get_tasks` | List tasks with filters | `project_id`, `filter`, `priority`, `limit` |
| `todoist_update_task` | Update a task by ID or name | `task_id`/`task_name`, `content`, `description`, `due_string`, `priority`, `labels`, `assignee_id` |
| `todoist_delete_task` | Delete a task | `task_id`/`task_name` |
| `todoist_complete_task` | Mark a task as complete | `task_id`/`task_name` |
| `todoist_reopen_task` | Reopen a completed task | `task_id`/`task_name` |

### Project Tools (7)

| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `todoist_get_projects` | List all projects | — |
| `todoist_get_project` | Get a single project | `project_id` |
| `todoist_create_project` | Create a project | `name`, `parent_id`, `color`, `is_favorite`, `view_style` |
| `todoist_update_project` | Update a project | `project_id`, `name`, `color`, `is_favorite` |
| `todoist_delete_project` | Delete a project | `project_id` |
| `todoist_archive_project` | Archive a project | `project_id` |
| `todoist_unarchive_project` | Unarchive a project | `project_id` |

### Section Tools (4)

| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `todoist_get_sections` | List sections | `project_id` (optional) |
| `todoist_create_section` | Create a section | `name`, `project_id`, `order` |
| `todoist_update_section` | Update a section | `section_id`, `name` |
| `todoist_delete_section` | Delete a section | `section_id` |

### Label Tools (4)

| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `todoist_get_labels` | List all labels | — |
| `todoist_create_label` | Create a label | `name`, `color`, `is_favorite` |
| `todoist_update_label` | Update a label | `label_id`, `name`, `color` |
| `todoist_delete_label` | Delete a label | `label_id` |

### Comment Tools (4)

| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `todoist_get_comments` | List comments | `task_id` or `project_id` |
| `todoist_create_comment` | Add a comment | `content`, `task_id` or `project_id` |
| `todoist_update_comment` | Update a comment | `comment_id`, `content` |
| `todoist_delete_comment` | Delete a comment | `comment_id` |

### GTD Workflow Tools (4)

| Tool | Description | How It Works |
|------|-------------|--------------|
| `todoist_inbox_review` | Inbox processing view | Auto-detects inbox project, groups tasks by age (today/this week/older) |
| `todoist_weekly_review` | Weekly review summary | Aggregates: projects with task counts, overdue tasks, tasks with no due date |
| `todoist_move_task` | Move task to project/section | `task_id`/`task_name`, `project_id`, `section_id` |
| `todoist_bulk_create_tasks` | Batch create tasks | `tasks[]` array with content, description, due_string, priority, project_id, section_id, labels |

## Prerequisites

- Go 1.25.7 or later
- A Todoist account
- Todoist API token

## Getting Your Todoist API Token

1. Log in to [Todoist](https://todoist.com)
2. Go to Settings → Integrations → Developer
3. Copy your API token from the "API token" section

## Installation

### From Source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist.git
cd mcp-todoist
make build
```

The binary will be available at `build/mcp-todoist`.

### Using Go Install

```bash
go install github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist@latest
```

## Usage

### Running Directly

```bash
export TODOIST_API_TOKEN="your_api_token_here"
./build/mcp-todoist
```

### Using Make

```bash
make run TODOIST_API_TOKEN=your_api_token_here
```

## Configuration with Claude Desktop

Add the following to your Claude Desktop configuration file:

**macOS:** `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`
**Windows:** `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json`
**Linux:** `~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "todoist": {
      "command": "/path/to/mcp-todoist",
      "env": {
        "TODOIST_API_TOKEN": "your_api_token_here"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Replace `/path/to/mcp-todoist` with the actual path to your built binary.

## Example Workflows

### GTD Inbox Processing

```
Review my Todoist inbox
→ Runs todoist_inbox_review, shows tasks grouped by age

Move the "research API" task to project Work, section Backlog
→ Runs todoist_move_task with project and section IDs
```

### Weekly Review

```
Run my weekly review
→ Runs todoist_weekly_review, shows project summaries, overdue tasks, undated tasks
```

### Batch Task Creation

```
Create these tasks in my "Reading List" project:
- Read "Thinking, Fast and Slow"
- Read "Deep Work"
- Read "Atomic Habits"
→ Runs todoist_bulk_create_tasks with 3 items
```

### Project Management

```
Show me all my projects
→ Lists all projects with IDs and inbox/favorite status

Create a new project called "Q1 Goals" with board view
→ Creates project with view_style: board
```

## Development

### Building

```bash
make build
```

### Running Tests

```bash
make test
```

### Code Coverage

```bash
make coverage
```

### Linting

```bash
make lint
```

### Running All Checks

```bash
make check
```

### Building for Multiple Platforms

```bash
make build-all
```

## Project Structure

```
mcp-todoist/
├── main.go                          # Thin entry point
├── internal/
│   ├── models/                      # Shared data types
│   │   ├── task.go
│   │   ├── project.go
│   │   ├── section.go
│   │   ├── label.go
│   │   └── comment.go
│   ├── todoist/                     # API client (no MCP awareness)
│   │   ├── client.go
│   │   ├── tasks.go
│   │   ├── projects.go
│   │   ├── sections.go
│   │   ├── labels.go
│   │   └── comments.go
│   └── tools/                       # MCP tool handlers
│       ├── register.go
│       ├── tasks.go
│       ├── projects.go
│       ├── sections.go
│       ├── labels.go
│       ├── comments.go
│       └── gtd.go
├── go.mod
├── go.sum
├── Makefile
└── README.md
```

## API Integration

This server uses the [Todoist API v1](https://developer.todoist.com/api/v1/) with full coverage of:

- Tasks: CRUD, complete, reopen, search by name or ID
- Projects: CRUD, archive, unarchive
- Sections: CRUD within projects
- Labels: CRUD for personal labels
- Comments: CRUD on tasks and projects
- GTD: Inbox review, weekly review, task moving, bulk creation

## License

MIT License - see [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.

## Acknowledgments

- Original TypeScript implementation by [abhiz123](https://github.com/abhiz123/todoist-mcp-server)
- Built with [go-sdk v1.3.0](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk)
- GitHub Actions and Makefile structure inspired by [mcp-obsidian](https://github.com/nsega/mcp-obsidian)

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please feel free to submit a Pull Request.

## Support

If you encounter any issues or have questions, please [open an issue](https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist/issues) on GitHub.

1→# Todoist MCP Server (Go)
     2→
     3→[![Build and Test](https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml)
     4→[![Go Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Go-1.26-00ADD8?logo=go&logoColor=white)](https://go.dev/)
     5→[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
     6→
     7→A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Todoist, written in Go. This server enables Claude and other MCP clients to interact with your Todoist tasks, projects, sections, labels, and comments using natural language. Includes GTD workflow tools for inbox processing and weekly reviews.
     8→
     9→This is a Go rewrite of the original [TypeScript implementation](https://github.com/abhiz123/todoist-mcp-server), built with the official [go-sdk v1.3.0](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk).
    10→
    11→## Features
    12→
    13→- **Full Todoist API Coverage**: 29 tools covering tasks, projects, sections, labels, and comments
    14→- **GTD Workflow Support**: Inbox review, weekly review, task moving, and bulk creation
    15→- **Smart Task Search**: Locate tasks via exact or partial name matching
    16→- **Flexible Filtering**: Organize tasks by due date, priority, project, and more
    17→- **Task ID Support**: Use task IDs directly or search by name
    18→
    19→## Available Tools
    20→
    21→### Task Tools (6)
    22→
    23→| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
    24→|------|-------------|----------------|
    25→| `todoist_create_task` | Create a new task | `content`, `description`, `due_string`, `priority`, `project_id`, `section_id`, `parent_id`, `labels`, `assignee_id` |
    26→| `todoist_get_tasks` | List tasks with filters | `project_id`, `filter`, `priority`, `limit` |
    27→| `todoist_update_task` | Update a task by ID or name | `task_id`/`task_name`, `content`, `description`, `due_string`, `priority`, `labels`, `assignee_id` |
    28→| `todoist_delete_task` | Delete a task | `task_id`/`task_name` |
    29→| `todoist_complete_task` | Mark a task as complete | `task_id`/`task_name` |
    30→| `todoist_reopen_task` | Reopen a completed task | `task_id`/`task_name` |
    31→
    32→### Project Tools (7)
    33→
    34→| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
    35→|------|-------------|----------------|
    36→| `todoist_get_projects` | List all projects | — |
    37→| `todoist_get_project` | Get a single project | `project_id` |
    38→| `todoist_create_project` | Create a project | `name`, `parent_id`, `color`, `is_favorite`, `view_style` |
    39→| `todoist_update_project` | Update a project | `project_id`, `name`, `color`, `is_favorite` |
    40→| `todoist_delete_project` | Delete a project | `project_id` |
    41→| `todoist_archive_project` | Archive a project | `project_id` |
    42→| `todoist_unarchive_project` | Unarchive a project | `project_id` |
    43→
    44→### Section Tools (4)
    45→
    46→| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
    47→|------|-------------|----------------|
    48→| `todoist_get_sections` | List sections | `project_id` (optional) |
    49→| `todoist_create_section` | Create a section | `name`, `project_id`, `order` |
    50→| `todoist_update_section` | Update a section | `section_id`, `name` |
    51→| `todoist_delete_section` | Delete a section | `section_id` |
    52→
    53→### Label Tools (4)
    54→
    55→| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
    56→|------|-------------|----------------|
    57→| `todoist_get_labels` | List all labels | — |
    58→| `todoist_create_label` | Create a label | `name`, `color`, `is_favorite` |
    59→| `todoist_update_label` | Update a label | `label_id`, `name`, `color` |
    60→| `todoist_delete_label` | Delete a label | `label_id` |
    61→
    62→### Comment Tools (4)
    63→
    64→| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
    65→|------|-------------|----------------|
    66→| `todoist_get_comments` | List comments | `task_id` or `project_id` |
    67→| `todoist_create_comment` | Add a comment | `content`, `task_id` or `project_id` |
    68→| `todoist_update_comment` | Update a comment | `comment_id`, `content` |
    69→| `todoist_delete_comment` | Delete a comment | `comment_id` |
    70→
    71→### GTD Workflow Tools (4)
    72→
    73→| Tool | Description | How It Works |
    74→|------|-------------|--------------|
    75→| `todoist_inbox_review` | Inbox processing view | Auto-detects inbox project, groups tasks by age (today/this week/older) |
    76→| `todoist_weekly_review` | Weekly review summary | Aggregates: projects with task counts, overdue tasks, tasks with no due date |
    77→| `todoist_move_task` | Move task to project/section | `task_id`/`task_name`, `project_id`, `section_id` |
    78→| `todoist_bulk_create_tasks` | Batch create tasks | `tasks[]` array with content, description, due_string, priority, project_id, section_id, labels |
    79→
    80→## Prerequisites
    81→
    82→- Go 1.25.7 or later
    83→- A Todoist account
    84→- Todoist API token
    85→
    86→## Getting Your Todoist API Token
    87→
    88→1. Log in to [Todoist](https://todoist.com)
    89→2. Go to Settings → Integrations → Developer
    90→3. Copy your API token from the "API token" section
    91→
    92→## Installation
    93→
    94→### From Source
    95→
    96→```bash
    97→git clone https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist.git
    98→cd mcp-todoist
    99→make build
   100→```
   101→
   102→The binary will be available at `build/mcp-todoist`.
   103→
   104→### Using Go Install
   105→
   106→```bash
   107→go install github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist@latest
   108→```
   109→
   110→## Usage
   111→
   112→### Running Directly
   113→
   114→```bash
   115→export TODOIST_API_TOKEN="your_api_token_here"
   116→./build/mcp-todoist
   117→```
   118→
   119→### Using Make
   120→
   121→```bash
   122→make run TODOIST_API_TOKEN=your_api_token_here
   123→```
   124→
   125→## Configuration with Claude Desktop
   126→
   127→Add the following to your Claude Desktop configuration file:
   128→
   129→**macOS:** `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`
   130→**Windows:** `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json`
   131→**Linux:** `~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`
   132→
   133→```json
   134→{
   135→  "mcpServers": {
   136→    "todoist": {
   137→      "command": "/path/to/mcp-todoist",
   138→      "env": {
   139→        "TODOIST_API_TOKEN": "your_api_token_here"
   140→      }
   141→    }
   142→  }
   143→}
   144→```
   145→
   146→Replace `/path/to/mcp-todoist` with the actual path to your built binary.
   147→
   148→## Example Workflows
   149→
   150→### GTD Inbox Processing
   151→
   152→```
   153→Review my Todoist inbox
   154→→ Runs todoist_inbox_review, shows tasks grouped by age
   155→
   156→Move the "research API" task to project Work, section Backlog
   157→→ Runs todoist_move_task with project and section IDs
   158→```
   159→
   160→### Weekly Review
   161→
   162→```
   163→Run my weekly review
   164→→ Runs todoist_weekly_review, shows project summaries, overdue tasks, undated tasks
   165→```
   166→
   167→### Batch Task Creation
   168→
   169→```
   170→Create these tasks in my "Reading List" project:
   171→- Read "Thinking, Fast and Slow"
   172→- Read "Deep Work"
   173→- Read "Atomic Habits"
   174→→ Runs todoist_bulk_create_tasks with 3 items
   175→```
   176→
   177→### Project Management
   178→
   179→```
   180→Show me all my projects
   181→→ Lists all projects with IDs and inbox/favorite status
   182→
   183→Create a new project called "Q1 Goals" with board view
   184→→ Creates project with view_style: board
   185→```
   186→
   187→## Development
   188→
   189→### Building
   190→
   191→```bash
   192→make build
   193→```
   194→
   195→### Running Tests
   196→
   197→```bash
   198→make test
   199→```
   200→
   201→### Code Coverage
   202→
   203→```bash
   204→make coverage
   205→```
   206→
   207→### Linting
   208→
   209→```bash
   210→make lint
   211→```
   212→
   213→### Running All Checks
   214→
   215→```bash
   216→make check
   217→```
   218→
   219→### Building for Multiple Platforms
   220→
   221→```bash
   222→make build-all
   223→```
   224→
   225→## Project Structure
   226→
   227→```
   228→mcp-todoist/
   229→├── main.go                          # Thin entry point
   230→├── internal/
   231→│   ├── models/                      # Shared data types
   232→│   │   ├── task.go
   233→│   │   ├── project.go
   234→│   │   ├── section.go
   235→│   │   ├── label.go
   236→│   │   └── comment.go
   237→│   ├── todoist/                     # API client (no MCP awareness)
   238→│   │   ├── client.go
   239→│   │   ├── tasks.go
   240→│   │   ├── projects.go
   241→│   │   ├── sections.go
   242→│   │   ├── labels.go
   243→│   │   └── comments.go
   244→│   └── tools/                       # MCP tool handlers
   245→│       ├── register.go
   246→│       ├── tasks.go
   247→│       ├── projects.go
   248→│       ├── sections.go

   252→├── go.mod

   256→```
   257→
   258→## API Integration
   259→
   260→This server uses the [Todoist API v1](https://developer.todoist.com/api/v1/) with full coverage of:
   261→
   262→- Tasks: CRUD, complete, reopen, search by name or ID
   263→- Projects: CRUD, archive, unarchive
   264→- Sections: CRUD within projects
   265→- Labels: CRUD for personal labels
   266→- Comments: CRUD on tasks and projects
   267→- GTD: Inbox review, weekly review, task moving, bulk creation

1→# Go parameters

     3→GO_CMD=go
     4→GO_BUILD=$(GO_CMD) build
     5→GO_CLEAN=$(GO_CMD) clean
     6→GO_TEST=$(GO_CMD) test
     7→GO_GET=$(GO_CMD) get

    10→GO_FMT=$(GO_CMD) fmt

    17→# Directories

    20→
    21→.PHONY: all build clean test lint fmt vet deps help install run check coverage tidy verify
    22→
    23→# Default target
    24→all: check build
    25→
    26→## help: Display this help message
    27→help:
    28→	@echo "Available targets:"
    29→	@echo "  make build        - Build the binary"
    30→	@echo "  make clean        - Remove build artifacts"
    31→	@echo "  make test         - Run tests"
    32→	@echo "  make coverage     - Run tests with coverage report"
    33→	@echo "  make lint         - Run linters (golangci-lint)"
    34→	@echo "  make fmt          - Format code"
    35→	@echo "  make vet          - Run go vet"
    36→	@echo "  make check        - Run all checks (fmt, vet, lint, test)"
    37→	@echo "  make deps         - Download dependencies"
    38→	@echo "  make tidy         - Tidy and verify dependencies"
    39→	@echo "  make verify       - Verify dependencies"
    40→	@echo "  make install      - Install the binary"
    41→	@echo "  make run          - Run the application (requires TODOIST_API_TOKEN environment variable)"
    42→	@echo "  make all          - Run checks and build"
    43→
    44→## build: Build the binary

    46→	@echo "Building $(BINARY_NAME)..."
    47→	@mkdir -p $(BUILD_DIR)

    49→	@echo "Built: $(BUILD_DIR)/$(BINARY_NAME)"

    51→## clean: Remove build artifacts and test cache

    68→	@mkdir -p $(COVERAGE_DIR)

    78→	@echo "Code formatted"

    84→	@echo "go vet passed"

    94→		$(MAKE) fmt vet; \

    99→	@echo "All checks passed!"

# Todoist MCP Server (Go)

[![Build and Test](https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml)
[![Go Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Go-1.26-00ADD8?logo=go&logoColor=white)](https://go.dev/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Todoist, written in Go. This server enables Claude and other MCP clients to interact with your Todoist tasks, projects, sections, labels, and comments using natural language. Includes GTD workflow tools for inbox processing and weekly reviews.

This is a Go rewrite of the original [TypeScript implementation](https://github.com/abhiz123/todoist-mcp-server), built with the official [go-sdk v1.3.0](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk).

## Features

- **Full Todoist API Coverage**: 29 tools covering tasks, projects, sections, labels, and comments
- **GTD Workflow Support**: Inbox review, weekly review, task moving, and bulk creation
- **Smart Task Search**: Locate tasks via exact or partial name matching
- **Flexible Filtering**: Organize tasks by due date, priority, project, and more
- **Task ID Support**: Use task IDs directly or search by name

## Available Tools

### Task Tools (6)

| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `todoist_create_task` | Create a new task | `content`, `description`, `due_string`, `priority`, `project_id`, `section_id`, `parent_id`, `labels`, `assignee_id` |
| `todoist_get_tasks` | List tasks with filters | `project_id`, `filter`, `priority`, `limit` |
| `todoist_update_task` | Update a task by ID or name | `task_id`/`task_name`, `content`, `description`, `due_string`, `priority`, `labels`, `assignee_id` |
| `todoist_delete_task` | Delete a task | `task_id`/`task_name` |
| `todoist_complete_task` | Mark a task as complete | `task_id`/`task_name` |
| `todoist_reopen_task` | Reopen a completed task | `task_id`/`task_name` |

### Project Tools (7)

| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `todoist_get_projects` | List all projects | — |
| `todoist_get_project` | Get a single project | `project_id` |
| `todoist_create_project` | Create a project | `name`, `parent_id`, `color`, `is_favorite`, `view_style` |
| `todoist_update_project` | Update a project | `project_id`, `name`, `color`, `is_favorite` |
| `todoist_delete_project` | Delete a project | `project_id` |
| `todoist_archive_project` | Archive a project | `project_id` |
| `todoist_unarchive_project` | Unarchive a project | `project_id` |

### Section Tools (4)

| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `todoist_get_sections` | List sections | `project_id` (optional) |
| `todoist_create_section` | Create a section | `name`, `project_id`, `order` |
| `todoist_update_section` | Update a section | `section_id`, `name` |
| `todoist_delete_section` | Delete a section | `section_id` |

### Label Tools (4)

| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `todoist_get_labels` | List all labels | — |
| `todoist_create_label` | Create a label | `name`, `color`, `is_favorite` |
| `todoist_update_label` | Update a label | `label_id`, `name`, `color` |
| `todoist_delete_label` | Delete a label | `label_id` |

### Comment Tools (4)

| Tool | Description | Key Parameters |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `todoist_get_comments` | List comments | `task_id` or `project_id` |
| `todoist_create_comment` | Add a comment | `content`, `task_id` or `project_id` |
| `todoist_update_comment` | Update a comment | `comment_id`, `content` |
| `todoist_delete_comment` | Delete a comment | `comment_id` |

### GTD Workflow Tools (4)

| Tool | Description | How It Works |
|------|-------------|--------------|
| `todoist_inbox_review` | Inbox processing view | Auto-detects inbox project, groups tasks by age (today/this week/older) |
| `todoist_weekly_review` | Weekly review summary | Aggregates: projects with task counts, overdue tasks, tasks with no due date |
| `todoist_move_task` | Move task to project/section | `task_id`/`task_name`, `project_id`, `section_id` |
| `todoist_bulk_create_tasks` | Batch create tasks | `tasks[]` array with content, description, due_string, priority, project_id, section_id, labels |

## Prerequisites

- Go 1.25.7 or later
- A Todoist account
- Todoist API token

## Getting Your Todoist API Token

1. Log in to [Todoist](https://todoist.com)
2. Go to Settings → Integrations → Developer
3. Copy your API token from the "API token" section

## Installation

### From Source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist.git
cd mcp-todoist
make build
```

The binary will be available at `build/mcp-todoist`.

### Using Go Install

```bash
go install github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist@latest
```

## Usage

### Running Directly

```bash
export TODOIST_API_TOKEN="your_api_token_here"
./build/mcp-todoist
```

### Using Make

```bash
make run TODOIST_API_TOKEN=your_api_token_here
```

## Configuration with Claude Desktop

Add the following to your Claude Desktop configuration file:

**macOS:** `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`
**Windows:** `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json`
**Linux:** `~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "todoist": {
      "command": "/path/to/mcp-todoist",
      "env": {
        "TODOIST_API_TOKEN": "your_api_token_here"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Replace `/path/to/mcp-todoist` with the actual path to your built binary.

## Example Workflows

### GTD Inbox Processing

```
Review my Todoist inbox
→ Runs todoist_inbox_review, shows tasks grouped by age

Move the "research API" task to project Work, section Backlog
→ Runs todoist_move_task with project and section IDs
```

### Weekly Review

```
Run my weekly review
→ Runs todoist_weekly_review, shows project summaries, overdue tasks, undated tasks
```

### Batch Task Creation

```
Create these tasks in my "Reading List" project:
- Read "Thinking, Fast and Slow"
- Read "Deep Work"
- Read "Atomic Habits"
→ Runs todoist_bulk_create_tasks with 3 items
```

### Project Management

```
Show me all my projects
→ Lists all projects with IDs and inbox/favorite status

Create a new project called "Q1 Goals" with board view
→ Creates project with view_style: board
```

## Development

### Building

```bash
make build
```

### Running Tests

```bash
make test
```

### Code Coverage

```bash
make coverage
```

### Linting

```bash
make lint
```

### Running All Checks

```bash
make check
```

### Building for Multiple Platforms

```bash
make build-all
```

## Project Structure

```
mcp-todoist/
├── main.go                          # Thin entry point
├── internal/
│   ├── models/                      # Shared data types
│   │   ├── task.go
│   │   ├── project.go
│   │   ├── section.go
│   │   ├── label.go
│   │   └── comment.go
│   ├── todoist/                     # API client (no MCP awareness)
│   │   ├── client.go
│   │   ├── tasks.go
│   │   ├── projects.go
│   │   ├── sections.go
│   │   ├── labels.go
│   │   └── comments.go
│   └── tools/                       # MCP tool handlers
│       ├── register.go
│       ├── tasks.go
│       ├── projects.go
│       ├── sections.go
│       ├── labels.go
│       ├── comments.go
│       └── gtd.go
├── go.mod
├── go.sum
├── Makefile
└── README.md
```

## API Integration

This server uses the [Todoist API v1](https://developer.todoist.com/api/v1/) with full coverage of:

- Tasks: CRUD, complete, reopen, search by name or ID
- Projects: CRUD, archive, unarchive
- Sections: CRUD within projects
- Labels: CRUD for personal labels
- Comments: CRUD on tasks and projects
- GTD: Inbox review, weekly review, task moving, bulk creation

## License

MIT License - see [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.

## Acknowledgments

- Original TypeScript implementation by [abhiz123](https://github.com/abhiz123/todoist-mcp-server)
- Built with [go-sdk v1.3.0](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk)
- GitHub Actions and Makefile structure inspired by [mcp-obsidian](https://github.com/nsega/mcp-obsidian)

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please feel free to submit a Pull Request.

## Support

If you encounter any issues or have questions, please [open an issue](https://github.com/nsega/mcp-todoist/issues) on GitHub.
